title: 实现 Library/Asset/Scan 只读核心
risks: AssetIdentity commit and ScanReconciliation terminal journaling are separate module ports; a journal failure after successful commit leaves a complete asset snapshot with a stale running scan until a later durable outbox/reconciliation task repairs it.
No production PostgreSQL adapter, dependency-injection composition or API endpoint is included; the core contracts and migrations are not yet a runnable product flow.

Synchronous operating-system metadata calls cannot be forcibly cancelled while a kernel or NAS call is stalled; production still needs isolated workers and health supervision around the application timeout contract.
The 10,000-entry bounded-batch test is not a substitute for the planned 500,000-asset production profile or real NAS failure/capacity exercise.

reused_existing_logic: V01-003 checksum-pinned forward-only migration manifest, module schema owners/default privileges and task-local PostgreSQL 16.15 integration harness
Existing .NET 10/C# 14 solution conventions, MSTest packages, centralized package locking and Microsoft.Extensions.Logging abstraction
M0-009 handoff, architecture baseline, repository verifier, three-tier CI concept and v0.1-start release gate
Platform file metadata and enumeration APIs behind a read-only Infrastructure port; no alternate filesystem abstraction or write helper
duplicated_logic: Library-root overlap is intentionally evaluated in C# for preflight feedback and independently in PostgreSQL under a per-storage-source advisory lock for concurrent enforcement; this is reviewed defense in depth across trust boundaries.
cross_module_access: ScanReconciliation.Application consumes only LibraryStorage.Contracts and AssetIdentity.Contracts public query/session ports.
Database migrations create and write only their owning schemas; there are no cross-schema foreign keys or writes.
contract_changes: Internal C# contracts add library/storage/root identities, stable entry and normalized path values, asset observation sessions, initial scan results and read-only discovery/journal ports; contracts/** and AssetLink wire formats are unchanged.
Production database manifest grows contiguously from migrations 1-2 to 1-5 with module-owned LibraryStorage, AssetIdentity and ScanReconciliation objects and no edits to applied migrations.
Initial scan persistence explicitly distinguishes an empty committed snapshot from an unscanned library and refuses replacement of an existing initial index.
architecture_tests: 43 ReadCore MSTest cases plus the full 58-test .NET solution, locked restore, format, Release build, dependency/source policy and vulnerability audit
25 static database tests and 6 required PostgreSQL 16.15 integration tests covering overlap, snapshots, abort, mixed-library refusal and least privilege
29 repository, 14 architecture, 14 generated-SDK and 21 AssetLink contract/spike tests plus 5 TypeScript Node tests and the Kotlin generated-SDK verification task
Repository verifier, migration manifest, handoff validator, architecture baseline, v0.1-start release gate, git diff check, cache-residue and task-process checks
technical_debt: Add durable outbox/reconciliation for an AssetIdentity commit followed by ScanReconciliation journal-finalization failure in V01-005/V01-006.
Select and implement the production PostgreSQL adapters and composition without bypassing module ports or introducing an unfrozen data-access dependency.
Run the scheduled 500,000-asset, NAS interruption, permission-change and capacity profiles before release.
Keep synchronous filesystem metadata work behind supervised isolated workers because cancellation cannot interrupt every stalled OS/NAS call.
